    SmallMittens' tuna melt bitesTuna, mayo, celery and pickle on toasted English muffinsHow to make it2 tins of tuna (185g each), drained3 tbsp mayonnaise1 celery stick, finely diced1 tbsp chopped pickles1/2 lemon4 English muffins150g cheddar, gratedpepper, to tasteSplit and toast the muffins.Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise, celery, pickles, a squeeze of lemon and pepper.Spread over the muffin halves and top with cheddar.Grill until the cheese is bubbling and golden.Cut each half into quarters and serve warm.Rhino's cheese ballsCheddar cream cheese balls in walnuts. Let it begin!How to make it200g cheddar, grated250g cream cheese2 tbsp chives, snipped100g walnuts, finely chopped1 box water crackersMix the cheddar, cream cheese and chives until well combined.Roll into small balls.Coat in the chopped walnuts.Chill until firm.Serve piled in a bowl with the crackers.Packing peanut cheese popcornBolt ships to New York in a box of theseHow to make itNot on tonight's cookPopcorn tossed in melted butter with finely grated cheddar, parmesan, smoked paprika and a little chilli, hitting the jackpot in every handful.Heat 3 tbsp oil and 120g popcorn kernels in a big lidded pot over medium-high heat, shaking until the popping slows.Tip into a large bowl.Melt 60g butter with 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1/2 tsp chilli powder and pour over.Blitz 50g grated cheddar and 30g parmesan to a fine powder and toss through with 1 tsp salt.Serve in paper cones.Bacon wrapped hot dogs with onionsMittens taught Bolt to beg for food like this.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.BigRoad trip diner meatloafOhio in the back of a U-Haul. Meatloaf and potatoesHow to make it800g beef mince1 onion, grated1 cup breadcrumbs1 egg1 tsp salt100ml tomato sauce1kg potatoes50g butter100ml milkMix the mince, onion, breadcrumbs, egg and salt.Press into a loaf tin and spread with tomato sauce.Bake at 180°C until cooked through.Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and milk.Slice the meatloaf thickly and serve on the mash.Hollywood studio chicken burrito bowlChicken bowl. No green eyed man.How to make itNot on tonight's cookLime and garlic chargrilled chicken over coriander rice with black beans, charred corn, avocado, pickled onion and chipotle mayo.Marinate 800g chicken thighs in the juice of 2 limes, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and oil for 30 minutes.Cook 300g rice and stir through chopped coriander.Grill the chicken 5 minutes a side and slice.Char 2 corn cobs and cut off the kernels.Slice 1 red onion and soak in lime juice for 10 minutes.Build bowls with rice, warmed black beans, chicken, corn, avocado, onion and mayo mixed with chipotle.SweetLightning bolt cookiesShortbread bolts. The power of StyrofoamHow to make it250g butter, softened100g caster sugar350g plain flour150g icing sugar2 tbsp waterBeat the butter and sugar until creamy.Mix in the flour to a soft dough.Roll out and cut into lightning bolt shapes.Bake at 160°C until pale golden.Cool on the tray.Mix the icing sugar and water and ice the cookies white.SipsChocolate malt thickshakeThick enough for a super barkHow to make it600ml chocolate ice cream600ml cold milk4 tbsp malted milk powder1 tbsp cocoa100ml whipped cream50g chocolate malt ballsBlend the ice cream, milk, malted milk powder and cocoa until thick.Pour into chilled tall glasses and top with whipped cream.Crush the malt balls and scatter over in a zigzag like a lightning bolt.Lime agua frescaPenny's set break drink, between takes.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
